fieldData.main-content:
Due to the inability to transfer the Superadmin of a public telegram channel we have decided to take the extraordinary step of migrating our Telegram channel manually.

Old Channel: https://t.me/radixDLT

‍New Channel: https://t.me/radix_dlt‍

This is a pre-emptive security move after a security audit of our social media channels.‍

‍

Sorry for the inconvenience.
fieldData.seo-meta-description: Information regarding our manual transfer from the old, archival Radix channel to the new one.
fieldData.name: Updated Telegram Channel
